# Vishome Global Commercial Carpet Co., Ltd.

> B2B commercial carpet manufacturer based in Tianjin, China. We supply carpet tiles, hotel broadloom, wall-to-wall carpets, and custom printed flooring to 45+ countries for hotels, offices, airports, retail, and public infrastructure projects.

## Company Overview

- **Full Name**: Vishome Global Commercial Carpet Co., Ltd.
- **Brand**: Visfurn (short name used online)
- **Website**: https://www.vishomecarpet.com
- **Location**: Cuihuangkou Town, Wuqing District, Tianjin 301700, China
- **Factory Size**: 50,000 m²
- **Employees**: 900+
- **Export Markets**: 45+ countries including USA, UK, UAE, India, Germany, Australia, Canada
- **Experience**: 15+ years in commercial carpet manufacturing
- **Primary Email**: sales@vishomecarpet.com
- **Backup Email**: oilero@outlook.com
- **WhatsApp**: +86 152 2288 5400

## Products

- **EcoCore PVC-Free PE Backing Carpet Tiles**: 50×50 cm modular carpet tiles for offices, schools, green buildings, coworking spaces, and commercial interiors. PVC-free PE backing, low-VOC option, easy tile replacement, lead time 10-20 days.
- **Premium Nylon 6.6 Commercial Carpet Tiles**: 50×50 cm modular carpet tiles for corporate offices, corridors, hotels, and retail. ASTM E648 Class I fire rating, Class 33 heavy commercial option, MOQ 200 SQM, lead time 10-14 days.
- **3D HD Printed Nylon Hotel Carpet**: 4m wall-to-wall printed nylon broadloom for hotel guestrooms, corridors, lobbies, ballrooms, casinos, and restaurants. FOB price range US$3.50-7.80/SQM, MOQ 300 SQM, lead time about 25 days.
- **Glitter Hotel Corridor Broadloom Carpet**: Blue and gold glitter-pattern 4m wall-to-wall broadloom carpet for hotel corridors, lobbies, ballrooms, and luxury hospitality projects. FOB price range US$4.20-8.60/SQM, MOQ 300 SQM, lead time 25-35 days.
- **Natural Sisal Linen-Weave Commercial Carpet**: 100% natural sisal flatweave carpet for offices, retail, galleries, exhibition halls, and hotel public areas. FOB price range US$6.50-14.80/SQM, MOQ 300 SQM, lead time about 30 days.
- **Axminster 80/20 Wool Blend Hotel Carpet**: Custom jacquard woven broadloom for 5-star hotel guest rooms and corridors, 4m width, MOQ 500 SQM, lead time about 30 days.
- **Public Area Corridor Carpet**: Heavy-duty solution-dyed nylon broadloom for airports, exhibition centers, corridors, and high-traffic public areas, MOQ 300 SQM.
- **Custom Carpet**: Digital printing, custom color matching (Pantone/RAL), custom hotel patterns, logo integration, OEM/ODM and project-based sampling.

## Certifications

- ASTM E648 Class I (Fire Rating)
- CRI Green Label Plus (Indoor Air Quality)
- CE Standards

## B2B Capabilities

- Minimum Order: 200–500 sqm depending on product type
- Lead Time: 10–35 days depending on specification
- FOB Price Signals: 3D printed hotel carpet US$3.50-7.80/SQM; natural sisal commercial carpet US$6.50-14.80/SQM; other products quoted by specification and quantity
- Custom Colors: Pantone/RAL matching, digital printing, solution-dyeing
- Custom Patterns: Jacquard loom, logo integration, branded designs
- Logistics: DDP/CIF/FOB global shipping, export packaging, consolidated container support
- Sampling: Free physical sample dispatch available on request

## Target Clients

Hotels (5-star and boutique), Office developers, Interior designers, Flooring contractors, Retail chains, Airports and transport hubs, Hospitality procurement groups in North America, Europe, Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.
